items.title: 雖然 Trump 說 Tim Cook 是最適合接任黃仁勳 Nvidia CEO 位置的人選，但我覺得最能發揮 Cook 所長的應該只有成本管理 / Trump says Tim Cook is…
items.content:
雖然 Trump 說 Tim Cook 是最適合接任黃仁勳 Nvidia CEO 位置的人選，但我覺得最能發揮 Cook 所長的應該只有成本管理 / Trump says Tim Cook is the best person to take Jensen Huang’s place as Nvidia CEO, but I think where Cook’s strengths would shine most is cost management 雖然 Trump 說 Tim Cook 是最適合接任黃仁勳 Nvidia CEO 位置的人選，但我覺得最能發揮 Cook 所長的應該只有成本管理。根據我側面觀察 Apple 供應鏈管理超過 10 年以上的經驗，來對比這幾年追蹤與研究 Nvidia 的心得，我覺得 Nvidia 在供應鏈成本管理上，還有明顯的改善空間。
 其他方面，特別是最重要的新技術規劃與開發，不要說 Cook 了，目前已經證明能在維持快速商業化迭代更新下，把人類最先端的各領域技術導入 AI 晶片與機櫃方案的 CEO，這件事做得明顯好的只有黃仁勳（當然未來應該還會有其他人也能證明可以把這件事做很好）。
 —
 Trump says Tim Cook is the best person to take Jensen Huang’s place as Nvidia CEO, but I think where Cook’s strengths would shine most is cost management. Having watched Apple’s supply chain management from the sidelines for more than 10 years, and comparing that with what I’ve learned tracking and researching Nvidia in recent years, I think Nvidia still has clear room for improvement in supply chain and cost management.
 As for everything else, especially the most important part, planning and developing new technologies, this isn’t just about Cook. So far, the only CEO who has clearly proven he can do this well, bringing humanity’s most cutting-edge technologies from across fields into AI chips and rack solutions while keeping up a fast pace of commercial iteration, is Jensen Huang. (Of course, others will likely prove they can do this well in the future too.)

items.title: 重點分析 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳辭職 / Key takeaways on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation
items.content:
重點分析 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳辭職：
 1. 短期利空出盡：
對股市而言，短期內可能是一次性的利空出盡。黃仁勳目前已與 Nvidia 完全切割，接下來國會傳喚黃仁勳及後續調查，對 Nvidia 股價的影響應該會較小。至於黃仁勳離職後的動向對 Nvidia 的影響，在調查結果出爐前，現在就下判斷仍言之過早。
 2. Google TPU 為直觀下的最大受益者：
在 Nvidia 面臨接班不確定性下，Google TPU 可能有機會進一步取得客戶與供應鏈信任，其核心合作廠商聯發科與 Broadcom 或為短期市場焦點。
 3. 接班影響最快自 2028 年浮現：
目前 CFO Colette Kress 擔任代理執行長。後續正式 CEO 交接與相應的組織改革，對 Nvidia 產品開發與競爭力的影響，預期最快可能自 2028 年開始浮現。
 4. 產能預訂與規格升級為供應鏈研究焦點：
黃仁勳的產品策略對供應鏈有兩大激進影響：「產能預訂」與「規格升級」。未來需密切關注供應鏈在擴產與新技術開發方面有無變化，這是支撐 Nvidia 供應鏈高本益比的核心因素之一。
 5. 中國需求與出口管制：
Nvidia 最終流向中國買家的 AI 晶片營收比重，可能高於過去對外的正式聲明。因此，有些投資人擔心，美國政府實施更嚴格的出口管制後，Nvidia 營收將顯著衰退。不過，中國終端需求並不會因出口管制而消失。即使出口管制加嚴，只要海外仍存在轉售管道，即使轉售價格高出數倍，中國買家仍有可能承擔溢價並輾轉取得 Nvidia 晶片／機櫃。
 —
 Key takeaways on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation:
 1. Near term, the bad news is priced in:
For the stock market, this could be a one-time clearing event. Huang has now fully cut ties with Nvidia, so Congress summoning him and any follow-up investigations should have less impact on Nvidia’s stock from here. As for how Huang’s next moves might affect Nvidia, it’s too early to call before the investigation results are out.
 2. Google’s TPU is likely the biggest beneficiary:
With Nvidia facing succession uncertainty, Google’s TPU has a chance to win more trust from customers and the supply chain. Its key partners, MediaTek and Broadcom, could be the market’s near-term focus.
 3. Succession impact shows up in 2028 at the earliest:
CFO Colette Kress is now interim CEO. The formal CEO transition and the organizational changes that come with it will likely start affecting Nvidia’s product development and competitiveness in 2028 at the earliest.
 4. Capacity pre-booking and spec upgrades are the key focus for supply chain checks:
Huang’s product strategy pushed the supply chain hard in two ways: capacity pre-booking and spec upgrades. It’s critical to watch for any changes in capacity expansion and new tech development across the supply chain. These are among the core reasons Nvidia’s supply chain trades at high P/E multiples.
 5. China demand and export controls:
The share of Nvidia’s AI chip revenue that ultimately ends up with Chinese buyers may be higher than what the company has officially stated. That’s why some investors worry Nvidia’s revenue will drop sharply once the US government tightens export controls. But China’s end demand won’t disappear because of export controls. Even under tighter rules, as long as overseas resale channels exist, Chinese buyers may still pay the premium, even at several times the price, and get Nvidia chips/racks through indirect routes.

items.title: Jensen Huang matters to Nvidia because he can take technologies his engineers believe are possible…
items.content:
Jensen Huang matters to Nvidia because he can take technologies his engineers believe are possible and turn them into products the whole company commits resources to, takes risks on, and has to deliver… Jensen Huang matters to Nvidia because he can take technologies his engineers believe are possible and turn them into products the whole company commits resources to, takes risks on, and has to deliver. That’s why the supply chain gets such strong order visibility and is willing to keep up with aggressive spec upgrades. It also forces competitors to follow, which drives technology upgrades and supply chain investment across the entire AI industry.
 Between the two, deciding on aggressive spec upgrades and making them happen is the harder part, compared with giving the supply chain order visibility. Huang doesn’t need to be the person at Nvidia who knows the most about new technologies like HVDC, CPO/NPO, or CCL/PTFE. His value is that he weighs strategy, organization, technology, and supply chain all at once, then makes the call quickly and puts resources behind it.
 Based on what’s public so far, it looks hard for Huang to come out of this unscathed. If so, the practical move may be to gradually reduce Nvidia’s reliance on Huang’s personal decision-making while preparing a succession plan. Along the way, two things are worth watching to gauge where AI technology and investment are heading: whether Nvidia can keep developing new products and technologies as efficiently as before, and how competitors respond. Supply chain research will be an important basis for that judgment.

items.title: 黃仁勳對 Nvidia 的重要性，在於他能把工程團隊認為可能實現的技術，轉化成全公司願意投入資源、承擔風險…
items.content:
黃仁勳對 Nvidia 的重要性，在於他能把工程團隊認為可能實現的技術，轉化成全公司願意投入資源、承擔風險，而且必須交付的產品。正因如此，供應鏈才能有極高的訂單能見度，並配合激進的規格升級。而這也帶動了競爭對手的跟進，進一步推動整體 AI 產業的技術升級與供應鏈投資。
 如果硬要比較，做出並落實激進規格升級的決策，比提供供應鏈訂單能見度更困難。黃仁勳不必是 Nvidia 內部最懂 HVDC、CPO/NPO 與 CCL/PTFE 等新技術的人，但他的價值，在於同時考慮到策略、組織、技術與供應鏈，並迅速拍板定案與投入資源執行。
 就目前公開資訊，黃仁勳似乎很難全身而退。在這前提下，比較務實的做法，可能是階段性降低 Nvidia 對黃仁勳個人的決策依賴，同時布局接班計畫。而在這過程中，Nvidia 能否延續高效的新產品與新技術研發，以及競爭對手如何因應，將是觀察整體 AI 產業技術發展與投資趨勢的重點，而供應鏈研究則能提供重要的判斷依據。
